item.title: Ask HN: Why is Open POWER Foundation a wasteland?
item.summary: Why is the Open POWER Foundation website a desolate post-apocalyptic wasteland compared to riscv.org? Just ten years ago PowerPC was getting so much love (at least, a little love). What has possessed people who relied on that ecosystem to dump it so wholeheartedly? Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49226638 Points: 2 # Comments: 1
